title: Car Rental Rate Classes Beside the Wanderlane Traveller Club and a Corporate Programme
content:
**1. A clause no longer in force.** The following sentence of this basis has been superseded by the current basis and is no longer in force, and is recorded here so that it is not applied: "Holding an active traveller club membership changes what this rental is charged: the club tier held on the collection date decides the discount applied to the rental rate and whether a vehicle class upgrade is offered, and the rate class's own terms decide everything else."

**2. A club discount and a corporate rate never stand together.** A club discount and a corporate programme rate are mutually exclusive on one rental: where the rental carries a corporate programme reference the negotiated rate stands alone and no club discount is applied on top of it.

**3. A class that is not eligible for a corporate rate.** A rate class that is not eligible for a corporate rate may still be booked under a programme, but at its public price.

**4. Upgrades.** A club upgrade is offered only on a rate class that permits it and only where the supplier has the higher class available; it is never converted into money or into a discount.

**5. Points.** Club points accrue on the rental total actually paid, at the earn rate of the rate class booked, and never on taxes, statutory fees, the deposit hold or the agency service fee. A corporate negotiated rate class earns no club points at all, whatever the renter's personal tier.

**6. Where a discount is applied at all, the basis is the club tier held on the collection date.**

**Exclusivity in a table.** On the Car Rental Rate Classes, one rental takes one of two footings.

| The rental carries | The rate that stands | The club discount |
|---|---|---|
| A corporate programme reference | The negotiated rate, standing alone | Not applied on top of it |
| No corporate programme reference | The class's own rate | Applied on the basis of the club tier held on the collection date |

**What the earn rate acts on, and what it never acts on.** Points accrue on the rental total actually paid at the earn rate of the class booked. They never accrue on taxes, on statutory fees, on the deposit hold or on the agency service fee. A corporate negotiated rate class earns no points at all, and a renter's own high personal tier does not alter that.

**The upgrade, twice over.** An upgrade requires two things together: a rate class that permits one, and a higher class the supplier actually has available. Where either is missing, no upgrade arises, and in no case is the upgrade turned into money or into a discount instead.
